intro: Stuttgart rewards visitors with car museums, hilltop vineyards and a compact, walkable centre. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Stadtbahn (U-Bahn): lines U1-U16, underground in the centre, fast and frequent.
S-Bahn: lines S1-S6 link the centre with suburbs and the airport.
Buses fill gaps; night buses run from Schlossplatz on weekends.
Taxis wait at Hauptbahnhof and the airport; ride apps like Uber and Bolt work but are limited.
Driving is slow at rush hour; the centre is a low-emission zone, so a green sticker is needed.
The centre is compact and walkable; bikes and e-scooters are common.

mercedes.name: Mercedes-Benz Museum
mercedes.price_text: ≈ EUR 16 adult · reduced ≈ EUR 8 · check on the day
mercedes.tip: Start at the top floor and spiral down through time; allow at least two hours.

porsche.name: Porsche Museum
porsche.price_text: ≈ EUR 14 adult · reduced ≈ EUR 7 · check on the day
porsche.tip: Combine with the Mercedes museum only if you have a full day; they are on opposite sides of town.

library.name: Stuttgart City Library
library.hours: Mon–Sat roughly 09:00–21:00 · check on the day
library.tip: Go up to the top floor and look down the white atrium; it is the best free photo spot in the city.

schlossplatz.name: Schlossplatz and Neues Schloss
schlossplatz.tip: Sit on the grass in summer and watch the fountain; the square is the city's living room.

marktplatz.name: Marktplatz and Markthalle food market
marktplatz.price_text: Free to browse · food from a few EUR
marktplatz.tip: Grab a snack from the stalls and eat it outside on the square.

killesberg.name: Killesberg Park and lookout tower
killesberg.price_text: Free · small fee for the park train
killesberg.tip: Climb the tower for a wide view over the city and vineyards.

weinberge.name: Stuttgart vineyard walk (Weinberge)
weinberge.price_text: Free to walk · wine tasting extra
weinberge.tip: Follow the marked paths above the city and stop at a wine tavern (Besenwirtschaft) in season.

fernsehturm.name: Stuttgart TV Tower (Fernsehturm)
fernsehturm.price_text: ≈ EUR 10–13 adult · check on the day
fernsehturm.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–22:00 · check on the day
fernsehturm.tip: Go up near sunset for views over the whole valley; bring a jacket, it is windy up there.

wilhelma.name: Wilhelma Zoo and Botanical Garden
wilhelma.price_text: ≈ EUR 18–22 adult · check on the day
wilhelma.hours: Daily from about 08:15 · closing varies by season
wilhelma.tip: Allow half a day; the historic Moorish buildings are as good as the animals.

schloss-solitude.name: Schloss Solitude
schloss-solitude.price_text: ≈ EUR 5–8 for the interior · grounds free
schloss-solitude.hours: Interior limited hours · check on the day
schloss-solitude.tip: The walk through the forest from the west of the city is the real reward.

stadtmuseum.name: Stadtmuseum Stuttgart
stadtmuseum.hours: Tue–Sun · closed Monday · check on the day
stadtmuseum.tip: Good rainy-day stop to understand how the city was rebuilt after the war.

kunstmuseum.name: Kunstmuseum Stuttgart
kunstmuseum.price_text: ≈ EUR 8–12 adult · check on the day
kunstmuseum.tip: The glass cube on Kleiner Schlossplatz is easy to spot; the top floor café has a good view.

cannstatter-wasen.name: Cannstatter Wasen festival ground
cannstatter-wasen.price_text: Free to enter · rides and food extra
cannstatter-wasen.tip: If you are here in late September or April, the Volksfest is a smaller, friendlier Oktoberfest.

bad-cannstatt.name: Bad Cannstatt old town walk
bad-cannstatt.tip: Wander the small streets and the river bank; it feels like a village inside the city.

mineralbad.name: MineralBad Cannstatt
mineralbad.tip: Soak in warm mineral water after a long day of walking.

city-tour.name: Stuttgart city walking tour
city-tour.hours: Usually daily late morning · check on the day
city-tour.tip: Book ahead in summer; the tour covers the Schlossplatz, market hall and old town.

eugensplatz.name: Eugensplatz viewpoint
eugensplatz.tip: A short climb from the centre gives you a postcard view over the valley.

weissenhof.name: Weissenhof Estate
weissenhof.price_text: Free to walk past · museum extra
weissenhof.tip: A UNESCO-listed row of 1920s modern houses; walk the street slowly.

pragsattel.name: Pragsattel viewpoint
pragsattel.tip: Local favourite for a wide view; bring a drink and stay for sunset.

bohnenviertel.name: Bohnenviertel neighbourhood walk
bohnenviertel.tip: Small old streets with cafés and bars; good for an evening stroll and dinner.

mercedes-arena.name: Mercedes-Benz Arena area walk
mercedes-arena.tip: Walk along the Neckar river here; on match days the area is lively but crowded.

degerloch.name: Degerloch forest walk
degerloch.tip: Easy paths through woods above the city; a good escape on a hot day.

cannstatter-volksfest-food.name: Swabian food stop (Maultaschen and Spätzle)
cannstatter-volksfest-food.hours: Lunch and dinner · check on the day
cannstatter-volksfest-food.tip: Try Maultaschen and a local beer; book a table for dinner on weekends.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Mercedes, Porsche and the Staatsgalerie in one compact centre.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Vineyards, parks and riverbank walks right in the city.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Swabian plates, market halls and wine taverns.

stays.why: Walk to the Schlossplatz, Staatsgalerie and main station. Best base for a first visit and for transit links.
Quiet, leafy streets with cafés and wine taverns. A short Stadtbahn ride or a walk downhill to the centre.
Near the Mercedes-Benz Museum, the Wasen festival ground and the mineral spas. Good S-Bahn links to the centre.
Hilltop area with views over the valley. Handy for the airport and the trade fair; quieter at night.

food: Try Swabian classics: Maultaschen (stuffed pasta), Spätzle with cheese, and Zwiebelrostbraten.
The Markthalle in the centre is good for a cheap lunch, local cheese and coffee; check opening days.
Look for a Besenwirtschaft (seasonal wine tavern) in the vineyards around Stuttgart for local wine and simple plates.
Beer gardens and brewery restaurants serve hearty plates; expect roughly EUR 12–20 for a main dish.
Book dinner on weekends. Many kitchens close early on Sundays; check on the day.
more_time: Add the Porsche Museum in Zuffenhausen if cars interest you; it is a separate trip from the Mercedes-Benz Museum.
Take the rack railway or cable car up to a viewpoint, then walk down through the vineyards.
In summer, swap a city afternoon for a half-day trip to Ludwigsburg Palace or Esslingen's old town.
